symptom: Quartz actuator job details do not expose execution information requested for operational diagnosis.
checkpoint: Confirm what the endpoint actually exposes before treating missing execution detail as scheduler failure.

symptom: Structured logging does not provide CSV output as a built-in format.
checkpoint: Separate an unsupported output format from a logging pipeline or encoder malfunction.

symptom: Operators cannot assign an execution timeout to individual health indicators, allowing a slow dependency check to delay health responses.
checkpoint: Measure each contributor and distinguish slow indicator execution from management-port reachability.

symptom: Spring Web Services observations are not auto-configured by Spring Boot.
checkpoint: Verify instrumentation ownership and available auto-configuration before diagnosing missing spans.

symptom: Application readiness events can be published before custom health contributors would report ready.
checkpoint: Do not equate lifecycle ReadinessState with the aggregate readiness health group; inspect both timelines.

symptom: OTLP meter registry auto-configuration lacks a direct way to supply OpenTelemetry resource attributes.
checkpoint: Inspect resource, meter, and exporter configuration independently; metric export does not prove resource attribution.

symptom: Kubernetes container lifecycle guidance leaves ambiguity around preStop, SIGTERM, readiness changes, and grace periods.
checkpoint: Reconstruct the platform event order and compare it with Spring shutdown phases before changing timeouts.

symptom: A long-lived server-sent-events connection prevents graceful shutdown from completing as expected by the reporter.
checkpoint: Classify long-lived streams separately from finite in-flight HTTP requests and align termination grace accordingly.

symptom: Jetty graceful shutdown coordination was proposed to use GracefulHandler rather than StatisticsHandler.
checkpoint: Identify the embedded server and exact Boot line because shutdown mechanics differ by server and version.

symptom: No built-in actuator drain endpoint reports completion of application-level asynchronous work during Kubernetes termination.
checkpoint: Do not infer queue or executor drainage from HTTP readiness or web-server graceful shutdown.

symptom: Spring Cache, Micrometer, and Caffeine integration produced unexpected observation or metric behavior.
checkpoint: Separate cache semantics, binder registration, and registry output before assigning the defect.

symptom: TestObservationRegistry validation sometimes throws InvalidObservationException after an upgrade.
checkpoint: Capture observation start, scope, stop, and registry-clear order in the failing test.

symptom: Using context propagation with a no-op observation can corrupt the current observation.
checkpoint: Inspect scope nesting and restoration across thread boundaries; do not diagnose it solely as missing tracing data.

symptom: Manually setting trace context on a scheduler thread with an active observation triggers scope mismatch warnings.
checkpoint: Model the observation and tracing scope stacks together and close them in strict nesting order.

symptom: A native application fails at startup when OTLP metrics are enabled.
checkpoint: Reproduce with metrics export disabled, then verify native reachability metadata and protobuf/exporter versions.

symptom: A custom ConstraintValidator receives a null injected dependency in a native image.
checkpoint: Compare JVM and native bean construction and inspect generated reachability hints before changing validation rules.

symptom: Native conversion involving Instant and Timestamp requires runtime hints not previously registered.
checkpoint: Identify the reflective conversion path and register the narrowest required hint.

symptom: GraalVM 25 reports a deprecation warning for the install-exit-handlers native build option.
checkpoint: Treat build-tool and GraalVM option compatibility separately from application runtime failures.

symptom: New GraalVM 25 reachability metadata options prompted a request for default build-plugin configuration.
checkpoint: Confirm which layer owns native-image flags: Framework hints, Boot plugin, build tools, or GraalVM.

symptom: Default interface method invocation through HTTP and RSocket service proxies fails in a native image.
checkpoint: Compare proxy metadata and invocation behavior on JVM and native before attributing the failure to transport.
